title: Deep Learning of Solver-Aware Turbulence Closures from Nudged LES Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2604.23874v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The differentiable physics paradigm may be leveraged as an a-posteriori approach for discovering turbulence closure models by embedding a neural network parameterization directly inside the solver and optimizing it given potentially sparse target data. This addresses a key limitation of a-priori learning where direct numerical simulation (DNS) data is used to approximate the subgrid stress with the assumption of a low-pass filter. Closures trained in this a-priori manner frequently lead to unstable deployments due to the mismatch between the assumed filter and the effect of numerical discretizations and coarse-graining. In comparison, while typically stable during deployment, a-posteriori learning incurs high computational costs due to the need to backpropagate through a large eddy simulation (LES) solver. translated_title: 基于Nudging大涡模拟（LES）动力学的求解器感知湍流闭合模型深度学习
translated_abstract: 可微物理范式可以作为一种后验方法来发现湍流闭合模型，其做法是将神经网络参数化直接嵌入求解器内部，并在可能稀疏的目标数据下对其进行优化。这解决了先验学习的一个关键局限：先验学习使用直接数值模拟（DNS）数据，并在低通滤波假设下近似亚格子应力。以这种先验方式训练的闭合模型在部署时常常不稳定，原因是所假设的滤波器与数值离散化及粗粒化的实际效应之间存在不匹配。相比之下，后验学习虽然通常在部署时较为稳定，但由于需要在大涡模拟（LES）求解器中进行反向传播，因此计算成本很高。此外，后验方法难以广泛应用，因为它们需要对现有求解器进行大量修改……
tldr: 该论文提出从Nudging LES动力学中学习求解器感知的湍流闭合模型，兼顾了先验学习的低训练成本与后验学习的部署稳定性，从而克服了两者各自的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper learns solver-aware turbulence closures from nudged LES dynamics, combining the low training cost of a-priori learning with the deployment stability of a-posteriori learning.
